_about: The videos Krish wants his own to look and sound like, and what each one teaches, by part of the craft. He drops a video in Drive > makeyourmindup > Video Engine > Inspiration and, if he likes, writes what he likes about it in the 'What I like' sheet in that folder. scripts/quick-edit/references.py measures it; a session writes the moves below (docs/STYLE_REFERENCES.md). Krish, 2026-10-14: 'Can you set up a folder where I can put videos that I really like the production quality of, as well as the narrative style, editing, camerawork, zooming, the way they break down a point, and the tone and style of communication, so that you can learn from them?' A move with house_default true changes how every video is made, and needs Krish's own words in krish_said.

references.creator: Hannah Fry
references.krish_likes: I generally love how she talks about complex topics observationally. She's not commentating on a specific thing or company but she's just unpacking how something works that people probably don't even realise they wondered about. I think the same is going to happen in AI and we could do a really good job of talking less about companies and more about concepts.
